about: Where each field of the structured shipment export (docs/shipment-export.md) lands in the eFTI common data set of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/2024, Annex, Table 1. Written by hand against the element definitions; measured against the subsets by app/services/efti.py. Source paths: consignment.<registry field>, goods[].<line field>, dangerous_goods[].products[].<product field>, compliance.<derived answer>, modality, documents[]. Kind: field (carried as such), derived (worked out by the application), translated (carried in the application's vocabulary, code list translation still to do).

mapping.note: Date of taking over (CMR box 4); the export carries a date, eFTI40 format code 102 (CCYYMMDD).
Sum over the lines, in kilograms; eFTI42 unit code KGM.
Sum of length x width x height x quantity where all three are given; MTQ. Lines without dimensions leave the consignment volume unanswered.
Sum of the quantities whose unit is a package count; a line in kilograms or litres does not count packages.
CMR box 16 / CIM box 28. The currency (eFTI855) is not a field of its own; the amount is entered as text.
CMR box 13, the sender's instructions.
CMR box 19, special agreements.
CMR box 13/18 free text.
prepaid / collect / agreement into CL-030 (UN/EDIFACT 4237); the code values are not in the Annex, the list is referenced by name.
CIM box 26 declared value; on the AWB instruction declared_value_carriage. Currency eFTI1150 not separated.
an..35 in the Annex; the export does not truncate.
Free text that holds a telephone number, an email address or a person's name; the export does not separate them, so eFTI53 is answered by the same text.

The country is read off the address the way the customs route reader does (ISO code or country name on the last line); the other address elements (eFTI54-62) are not separated, see the party model gap.
Free text, as for the consignor; eFTI71 answered by the same text.
Country read off the address; eFTI72-81 not separated.
The AVC waybill's carrier address; country read off it. Absent on the CMR, whose carrier box holds the name only.
The UN/LOCODE in brackets when the place was picked from the location database (CL-024 is UN/LOCODE); eFTI137 agency code 6 (UNECE).
Place of loading / taking over as written; place_of_receipt when it differs is the pre-carriage location, not this one.
Country read off the place; the postal elements eFTI141-151 are not separated.
UN/LOCODE in brackets when picked; place_of_delivery and final_destination outrank it as the receipt location when filled.
Falls back to discharge_point when no separate delivery place is given.
Country read off the receipt place; eFTI157-167 not separated.

cmr -> 730 Road consignment note. The CIM has no allowed code in CL-026 (720 is not among the allowed codes); 700 Waybill is the generic. imo_dgd, adn_transport_doc: the dangerous goods declaration is a related document (eFTI326 / eFTI833, CL-026 T-codes), not the transport document.
CMR box 21 / CIM box 29 date; eFTI1025 format 102.

mapping.source: consignment.shipment_reference, booking_number, purchase_order, customs_mrn, ens_mrn, aes_itn
mapping.note: One Trade shipment reference per filled field; the reference type code (eFTI181, CL-049 = UN/EDIFACT 1153) is not in the Annex by value and is still to be assigned per field.
Per consignment item (one per goods line); eFTI972 unit code from the line's unit via UNECE Recommendation 20 (CL-031), where a piece is H87 and a kilogram KGM.
Centimetres in the export, CMT in Recommendation 20.
Centimetres, CMT.
Centimetres, CMT.
The line descriptions, joined; an..512 in the Annex.
CIM box 24, six digits from the NHM 2025 list (v1.184.0), agency code 12 (UIC) in eFTI702; on the B/L instruction hs_code with agency 1 (CCC).
road -> 3, rail -> 2, sea -> 1, inland -> 8 (CL-037, Recommendation 19). Mandatory in EU05a and EU05c.
CMR box 25 / AVC; on the CIM wagon_number, on the ADN document vessel_name. The registration country (eFTI620) is not a field.
CMR, CIM (container_uti_number), IMO DGD, B/L instruction; eFTI375 agency 20 (BIC) for an ISO 6346 number.
CN (container) when a container number is given; the other CL-033 categories (tank-vehicle T1, swap body SW, semi-trailer SM) are not asked in the wizard.
The 1.1.3.6 points total over the transport unit, which the Annex calls the reportable quantity (BR-005).
Loaded dangerous goods per used transport equipment: the same UN numbers, when a container is given.
The points per product.
Four digits, CL-008 = Table A of chapter 3.2.
The technical name in brackets after the proper shipping name (SP 274 / 318); mandatory in EU05b (RID).
I, II, III into CL-036, which also carries the class 7 categories I-WHITE, II-YELLOW, III-YELLOW the application does not hold.
Gross mass per package times the number of packages; KGM. BR-101: not for UN 3509.
RID 5.4.1.1.1 (c) / ADN 5.4.1.1.2 (c): the label model numbers from Table A column (5), as the description line prints them; CL-002 is referenced by name, its codes are not in the Annex.
The hazard identification number of Table A column (20), as the placarding sheet prints it (CL-016).
When the 1.1.3.6.3 unit of the substance is litres (liquids, and gases by water capacity); LTR.
When the 1.1.3.6.3 unit is net kilograms (solids); KGM.
Class 1, kilograms (BR-035).
Supplemented with the technical name where SP 274 applies, which the description line builder does; the export carries the name as resolved for the document's language.
Table A column (15), CL-042; BR-064: only where the column carries a code other than '-'.
CL-023: 0, 1, 1a, 2, 3, 4 — the transport category of Table A column (15), as the points check reads it; BR-007: when 1.1.3.6 is used.
RID only (CL-021 code 1), optional.
5.4.1.2.3.1; CEL in eFTI280, type code T1 in eFTI281 (CL-013).
T1, the one code CL-013 allows, whenever a control temperature is given.
T1 whenever an emergency temperature is given.
BR-026: carriage in packagings.
The packaging as text; the 6.1.2 packaging code (eFTI297, CL-003) is not held as a code.
The marks and labels chapter 5.2 puts on each package, as the package label sheet derives them: the UN number mark and the label models (BR-088: lithium batteries label 9, class 7 label 7).

mapping.source: dangerous_goods[].products[].is_waste, empty_uncleaned, salvage_packaging, environmentally_hazardous, molten, classified_2_1_2_8, residue_classes, limited_quantity, excepted_quantity
mapping.note: CL-011: is_waste -> 8 WASTE IN ACCORDANCE WITH 2.1.3.5.5; empty_uncleaned -> 38 EMPTY, UNCLEANED (packagings 28-31 by kind); salvage_packaging -> 6 SALVAGE PACKAGING / 7 SALVAGE PRESSURE RECEPTACLE; environmentally_hazardous -> 4; molten -> 14 MOLTEN; classified_2_1_2_8 -> 13; residue_classes -> 39 RESIDUE, LAST CONTAINED with subject S2; excepted_quantity -> 36. Each is a condition statement of its own (ASBIE1077).
The statement text 5.4.1.1.19 / 5.4.1.2.1 (g) / 5.4.1.2.2 (e) as the description line builder prints it, with the subject code (eFTI309, CL-015) S2, S1, S3.
CL-015 subject: S2 residues, S1 fireworks classification, S3 name of the gas.
The technical name note where a generic or N.O.S. entry is characterised; eFTI1134 subject 4 (CL-044).
4 = further characterises a generic or N.O.S. proper shipping name, the case SP 274 covers.
Sum over the class 1 products, kilograms (BR-035).
The reportable quantity the 1.1.3.6 exemption is calculated on: the points total, against the threshold of 1,000.
CL-023, the category each product's points were counted in.
T14 Empty, uncleaned when every product on the equipment is an empty uncleaned means of containment; otherwise not answered.
CL-014: 1 when Regulation No 11 applies. The application does not decide that; it can only say a customs declaration exists.
General information on the dangerous goods, free text.
